description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'FileHelper' providing static methods for file handling operations such as obtaining files, creating file chooser dialogs with specific filters, saving user profiles to files, and configuring directory choosers. It is part of a larger ECU logging and tuning application.

classes.name: FileHelper
classes.description: A final utility class that provides static methods for common file operations in the context of ECU logging and profile management.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns a File object based on the provided file path, defaulting to the user's home directory if the path is null or empty.

methods.name: getProfileFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser configured for selecting ECU Logger profile XML files, given the last selected profile file.

methods.name: getDefinitionFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser configured for selecting ECU Logger definition XML files, given the last selected definition file.

methods.name: saveProfileToFile
methods.description: Saves a UserProfile object to a specified file, ensuring the filename ends with '.xml', and returns the file path.

methods.name: getLoggerOutputDirFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a directory-only JFileChooser initialized to the last output directory if it exists; otherwise defaults to the home directory.

methods.name: getFileChooser (private)
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser with a file filter for specific extensions, optionally initialized to a given file.

methods.name: getFileChooser (private)
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser initialized to the directory of the provided file, selecting that file if it exists.

search-terms: generate file chooser for XML profiles
